fixedIssues: The first TypeScript implementation resolved paths before I/O and remained vulnerable to parent-directory symlink replacement; it was removed and replaced by fd-relative traversal with O_NOFOLLOW.

The replacement initially leaked a directory fd when a deadline ToolError interrupted traversal and could report a retryable failure after os.replace had committed; the fd is now closed and every post-commit uncertainty returns unknown with exit code 4.

acceptedProperties: Every path starts from a fixed directory fd and traverses each component with dir_fd, O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW.
Read, edit, write, list and search reject reserved, noncanonical, absolute, traversal, backslash, control and symlink paths.
Inputs, files, queries, list entries, search files, search results, line previews and deadlines are bounded.
Writes use a same-directory temporary file, fsync, atomic replace and parent-directory identity checks.
A failure before atomic replace is failed; any uncertainty after the replace is unknown and therefore cannot be automatically retried.
Deterministic race tests cover parent replacement before commit and path replacement after commit without modifying an outside directory.
notAccepted: Project Sandbox effect executor and ToolDispatcher wiring
mapping process exit 4 and unknown:true into the durable command ledger
Linux Sandbox image, mount, permission, filesystem-flag and ambient-secret validation
serialization or content preconditions for competing project writers
startup garbage collection for temporary files left by process death
Bash process registry, executor deadline recheck, watchdog, cancellation and native-stop receipt
WorkspaceAgent alarm and real Pi Runtime
R2 Revision and Pi Session checkpoint
